Website Maintenance & Care Plans

Launch is the start, not the finish. DevEraXTech care plans keep your website or app secure, fast and up to date after it goes live, with updates, security patches, backups, uptime monitoring and one team to call when something needs to change. We look after sites we built and, after a short review, sites built elsewhere.

What's Covered

Care that keeps your site secure, fast and current

Every plan is built from the same core of careful, routine work. The plan you choose decides how much of it we handle and how quickly we respond.

7 areas of care

  • Updates. Core, theme, plugin and dependency updates, tested before they reach your live site.
  • Security patches. Vulnerabilities patched promptly, with security checks built into every round of updates.
  • Backups. Regular backups of your files and data, kept separate from your live server and ready to restore.
  • Uptime monitoring. Your site is monitored for uptime and issues, so we hear about outages early and act fast.
  • Performance checks. Periodic speed and Core Web Vitals reviews, with fixes when pages start to slow down.
  • Small content and feature changes. Text, image and layout updates, plus small feature additions, without starting a new project.
  • Priority support. Your requests are handled with priority, with a direct line to the team.

How It Works

From first review to ongoing care

  1. 01Review. We look at your website or app, hosting and current setup to understand what it needs.
  2. 02Choose a plan. We recommend a plan, agree the scope with you and set up backups and monitoring.
  3. 03Ongoing care. Updates, checks and your change requests are handled on a steady, predictable schedule.
  4. 04Clear reporting. You get regular summaries of what was done and what we suggest next.

Good to Know

Care plan questions

Can you maintain a website you did not build?+

Yes, in most cases. We start with a short review of the code, hosting and plugins so we know what we are taking on, and we tell you up front if anything needs fixing first.

Which platforms do your care plans cover?+

WordPress websites, Shopify stores and custom-built websites and web apps. If your setup is different, tell us about it and we will confirm whether we can look after it.

How much does a care plan cost?+

Each plan is scoped to your website or app, so we share pricing after the initial review rather than publishing a fixed price list.

Can I switch plans later?+

Yes. Your needs will change over time, and you can move between plans. We agree how changes work with you before any plan starts.
